name: Cosmos DB NoSQL
description: Query and edit Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL documents with partition-aware queries, JSON and field editors, and conditional single-document writes.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial macOS ARM64 release: partition-scoped Cosmos NoSQL queries, cached partition candidates, CodeMirror and field editing, and user-confirmed conditional single-document writes.

Requires DBX 0.6.59+. Adds read-only MCP tools compatible with MCP Server 0.4.134, searchable database/container selection with shared persistent location, query cancellation/status and selected SQL execution, improved table/JSON result tools and workbench layout. Existing defaults migrate automatically; enable MCP capabilities with a Read only ceiling. macOS ARM64 only.
